header.name: Advanced topics in Human Centered Computing (ATHC)
header.description: The course provides an advanced level undertstanding of current-day HCC frameworks and research methodologies. The aim of the course is to develop ability to conduct research in the area of HCC. During the course, the students will learn about existing frameworks and research methodologies that are currently used and also how to apply them.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Knowledge of current-day HCC frameworks and research methodologies

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to identify and apply, critique, and justify the suitable research framework for a given problem

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to develop research hypothesis and generate new ideas related to a research problem

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to evaluate and criticise existing computing and design soutions identifying the critical flaws in methodology, experimentation, evaluation etc. and ability to propose alternate solutions/approachs to address the flaws.

resources.title: Research papers form CHI, CSCW, ToCHI, UIST, UbiComp that to be discussed in class
